title: Valuation Desk Memorandum: Certificates, Accepted Laboratories and Condition Grades
content:
Two kinds of paper decide how a traded piece is treated under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes: the laboratory certificate that stands for the stone, and the condition grade the appraiser records for the piece. Each programme publishes whether a certificate is required, which laboratories it accepts, what is deducted where no accepted certificate is presented, which grades it will take a piece in at, and what each grade costs the valuation.

## Certificates

| Programme | Certificate required | Laboratories accepted | Deduction where no accepted certificate is presented |
|---|---|---|---|
| Belrose Standard Trade-In | no | none | 0 percent |
| Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee | yes | GIA, AGS | 100 percent |
| Bridal Upgrade Guarantee | yes | GIA, AGS | 100 percent |
| Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee | yes | GIA, AGS, IGI | 25 percent |
| Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege | yes | GIA, AGS, IGI, GUB | 100 percent |
| Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme | no | GIA, AGS, IGI, SSEF, GUB | 18 percent |

A certificate from a laboratory outside the programme's list is not an accepted certificate under that programme, whatever it says about the stone.

## Condition inspection and accepted grades

Every programme requires the piece to be inspected and graded before credit is issued. The grades each programme will take a piece in at are:

| Programme | Inspection required | Grades accepted |
|---|---|---|
| Belrose Standard Trade-In | yes | excellent, good, fair, damaged |
| Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee | yes | excellent, good |
| Bridal Upgrade Guarantee | yes | excellent, good |
| Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee | yes | excellent, good, fair |
| Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege | yes | excellent |
| Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme | yes | excellent, good, fair |

## Deduction from the valuation by grade

The published reduction to the valuation for the grade the piece was found at, as a percentage of the valuation, is:

| Programme | Excellent | Good | Fair | Damaged | Not inspected |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Belrose Standard Trade-In | 0 | 10 | 25 | 45 | 100 |
| Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee | 0 | 8 | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| Bridal Upgrade Guarantee | 0 | 8 | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee | 0 | 6 | 20 | 100 | 100 |
| Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege | 0 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme | 0 | 12 | 30 | 100 | 100 |

A deduction of 100 is the whole of the valuation. A grade that a programme does not accept carries a deduction of 100 under that programme, and a piece that has not been inspected carries a deduction of 100 under every programme.

## Points the desk is asked about

- A GIA certificate is accepted under every programme that accepts certificates at all; an SSEF certificate is accepted only under the Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme.
- Under the Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee a piece graded fair is accepted and carries a deduction of 20 percent; under the Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee the same grade is not accepted, and its published deduction is 100 percent.
